correctness.rationale: For any finite abelian A and T automorphism, the operation x*y=Tx+(1-T)y gives <S>_* = union_{s in S}(s+(1-T)H), H the T-invariant span of sample differences; finite right translations and their commutators establish both containments. The Fitting decomposition of U=1-T into nilpotent K and invertible C reduces generation to meeting every c=|K/UK| quotient class AND generating C as a module by k-1 independent uniform differences. The nilpotent quotient uses Nakayama-style surjective-plus-nilpotent=>zero, the C event is equivalent to spanning all simple polynomial heads M_p/f(T)M_p; finite-field head factors are jointly independent by CRT, giving the claimed coupon probability c!S(k,c)/c^k times product over f,j of (1-q_f^{j-(k-1)}), and minimum max(c,1+max r_f). Independent direct closure enumeration reproduced exact rational rates for trivial Z4, Z8 core, Z9 T=2, two inequivalent F3² T=-1/Jordan, irreducible F2², including k=2,3,4 cases. The arbitrary-module proof, not these finite checks, establishes all finite torsion and non-Latin cases.
residual_risks: The term finite Alexander quandle assumes T invertible; nonautomorphism or nonabelian generalized Alexander structures are excluded.
